content:
Optimism's development today focused on significant infrastructure improvements, including a critical hotfix for the `op-analytics` BigQuery pipeline and stability enhancements for `op-acceptor` in `infra`. Concurrently, the `optimism` monorepo saw extensive testing infrastructure fixes, a major code refactoring for Phase 6 cleanup, and the initiation of a large upstream merge in `op-geth` to integrate go-ethereum v1.17.1.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Core Infrastructure & Data Pipeline Enhancements
*   A hotfix was deployed to ensure the `op_stack_chain_metadata` table in BigQuery is correctly updated via the Dagster pipeline, resolving a previous data upload issue ([ethereum-optimism/op-analytics#1795](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-analytics/pull/1795)).
*   Fixed a CI hang issue in `op-acceptor` that occurred when all tests in a `RunAll` package were excluded, preventing unnecessary execution and CI stalls ([ethereum-optimism/infra#565](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/565)).

### Testing & CI/CD Pipeline Improvements
*   Fixed a flaky L2CLB snapshot test after disconnect to resolve ELSync triple-failure issues ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19418](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19418)).
*   Addressed a high rejection rate in `testFuzz_params_validValues_succeeds` by optimizing `vm.assume` calls, preventing frequent test failures or skips ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19410](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19410)).
*   Increased the Anvil startup timeout from 5s to 30s to fix flakiness in `TestImplementations` and `TestSuperchain` ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19424](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19424)).
*   Added `TestSupernodeInteropChainLag` to flake-shake to quarantine consistent flakiness in `memory-all` ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19413](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19413)).
*   Implemented a retry mechanism for L1 archive RPC calls in `print-pinned-block-number` to mitigate transient 5xx errors and prevent CI failures ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19421](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19421)).

### Core Stack Refactoring & Documentation
*   Completed Phase 6 cleanup by removing all backward compatibility type aliases, resulting in a significant reduction of ~1,200 net lines of code ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18877](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18877)).
*   Updated `op-reth` and `reth` to v1.11.1 and bumped the Rust MSRV from 1.88 to 1.92 across all configurations, Dockerfiles, and documentation ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19292](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19292)).
*   The `l2-upgrades-2-contracts.md` specification was moved from the `specs` repository into `packages/contracts-bedrock/specs/` within the `optimism` monorepo as part of a colocation trial ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19409](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19409)).
*   Documentation for L2 upgrade contracts was updated to redirect to its new location within the Optimism monorepo, improving co-location with implementations ([ethereum-optimism/specs#895](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/895)).
